Linsella is a True Soul who works in the kitchen in Moonrise Towers during Act Two.
“
You use a spoon to stir the soup, Barnabus. Forget the axe, my darling.
„
— Linsella, instructing Barnabus

Overview

Linsella was gifted by the Absolute the ability to "rewrite the lives of her faithful". Her ability enforces the condition  Dominated Will on creatures, and allows her to control them.

Involvement

Act Two

Linsella is in the Moonrise Towers kitchen at X: -116 Y: -178, training  'Barnabus', with the other gnolls  'Timothy' and  'Tomelia' nearby.

She offers to demonstrate her domination over the gnolls by forcing 'Barnabus' to dance or pray, during which his primal rage attempts to rebel against her hold.

Sever her control

The player character can sever her control, allowing the 'Barnabus' to murder his master:

  • [DARK URGE] [WISDOM] Compel the gnolls to pulp their master. (DC 16)
  • [OATH OF THE CROWN] [WISDOM] This is an abuse of power. Sever her control. (DC 16)
  • [WISDOM] Sever her control once and for all. (DC 16)

Successfully doing so rewards the following inspiration:

  • ⁠Gone Feral ( Urchin background)
  • ⁠No Strings to Hold Them Back ( Folk Hero background)
  • ⁠Pied Piper ( Charlatan background)
  • ⁠Who Let the Gnolls Out ( Haunted One background)

If freed from domination, the gnolls attack the party unless another ability check is passed:

  • [PERSUASION] Easy! I freed you - I'm a friend. (DC 16)
  • [INTIMIDATION] Try it - I dare you. (DC 16)
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Match it growl for growl. (DC 16)
  • [ILLITHID] [TRUE SOUL] [WISDOM] Now, now, Barnabus - behave. (DC 2)
  • [RANGER] [ANIMAL HANDLING] The creature thinks you prey - adjust your body language to display as a threat.' (DC 16 )

The  Dark Urge does not need to pass a check to pacify the gnolls because they are recognized by 'Barnabus': "...he grovels with a howl of pining awe..." and offers a few more lines of dialogue.

Reinforce her control

Alternatively, the player character can reinforce her domination:

  • [DARK URGE] Put aside dreams of mincing her. Help her take back control.
  • [OATH OF THE CROWN] Discipline is crucial. Help her assert her authority.
  • Reinforce her efforts with your own.

Linsella compliments the player character and rewards them with a  Severed Arm, and the following inspiration is gained:

  • ⁠Danse Macabre ( Entertainer background)
  • ⁠Pied Piper ( Charlatan background)

Do nothing

  • It seems you're not as commanding as you think.

If the last option is chosen, 'Barnabus' collapses and dies from the mental strain.
